name: riven-multistart-ga-1
description: Genetic search seeded with every Riven list of the current meta (Sacramento, RRO 25, Radiance release) so crossover can mix them; pool = all cards those lists play plus a few named ones; jury weighted toward the mirror and Kai'Sa while the engine's Kennen is under review.
